title: melissa graveolens
intro: Melissa graveolens, commonly known as lemon balm, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family. It is known for its calming and relaxing properties, which are attributed to its health benefits, such as reducing stress and anxiety, improving sleep quality, and alleviating symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome. The therapeutic actions of lemon balm include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe digestive issues and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Melissa graveolens include rosmarinic acid, melissic acid, and citral, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies.
